executiveSummary.headline: Turn Certified AI Presence Into Clearer Buyer Context
executiveSummary.lead: The Westin Tampa Waterside shows AI Consideration 45.3% and Scenario Presence 75% (peer #6 of 6) on the Dealality's latest AI visibility measurements. These measures do not diagnose a website defect. Priority work is to keep official facts accurate, document any automated-access constraints, and present demand-relevant strengths consistently for owners, GMs, and marketing teams.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration and Scenario Presence come from the Dealality's latest AI visibility measurements. Presence is not bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Certified Measurement Is the Baseline, Not a Website Verdict
themes.what: Consideration 45.3% / scenario 75% / peer #6 of 6 are retained from the certified ADP period without remeasurement.
themes.whyItMatters: Leadership should investigate visibility signals without treating the website as proven cause.

themes.title: Official Discovery Path Must Stay Accurate
themes.what: The official website did not return usable HTML to the automated probe; browser or brand-CDN confirmation may be required.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests, planners, and AI systems reuse official facts; broken or unreachable official pages undermine every recommendation.

themes.title: Destination and Partner Authority Is a Follow-On Opportunity
themes.what: Public partial Digital Authority research may identify destination inventories; unpaid research does not invent backlink counts.
themes.whyItMatters: Commercially relevant opportunities should be pursued only with verified pages and honest classifications.
